sheets.title: Reset this browser — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: Reset this browser on the unlock screen, as a desktop sheet. Measured in the browser: the erase square was rgb(179, 36, 36) with a white bin, and the sheet had three keys (Close in the head, Erase, and a second X, Keep it); every key and the mark had a 2px corner. Now the erase square is ink (rgb(23, 23, 23)), the sheet has two keys (Close and Erase), and every corner is 0px.
sheets.before: red erase square, a second X beside it, rounded corners
sheets.after: ink erase square, one close key, square corners

sheets.title: Reset this browser, phone — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The same sheet on a phone, in a coarse-pointer context. Before: red erase square, three 44×44 keys (Close, Erase, Keep it) and 2px corners. After: ink erase square, two 44×44 keys, 0px corners. The keyboard lands on the close key.
sheets.before: red erase square, a second X beside it, rounded corners
sheets.after: ink erase square, one close key, square corners
